messages:
Nina (SRE): Quick follow-up from the blameless retro 1: vendor/dependency outage mitigations. I want a concise action queue with owners, ETA, and acceptance criteria. Do we want these in the weekly sprint or a short "mini-sprint"?
Tom H: I'll take the multi-region failover validation + routing policy audit. Prefer a focused 10-day mini-sprint so we can coordinate CloudCo window. ETA: 2026-04-09.
Priya: I'll own model-registry auth resilience (refresh token jitter + client-side circuit breaker + exponential backoff). Plan: small PR + canary in staging. ETA: 2026-04-05. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/model-registry/pulls/3123
Marcus (Infra): I'll add smoke tests to the deploy pipeline and hook a post-deploy job: `tools/auth_flood_test.py --target model-registry --duration 30s`. Will post pipeline patch. ETA: 2026-04-03.
Oncall Bot: Incident created: #2026-33123. Automation: added recurring check `vendor-fallback-mini-drill` on calendar (monthly).
VendorOps: CloudCo: We acknowledge. We'll publish updated escalation contacts and a recommended retry-window doc by 2026-03-30. We'll also provide a test endpoint rate-limit for your dry runs.
Elena (Platform PM): Please CC product PMs on comms. Request: include customer impact thresholds and a short status note template for outbound comms.
Nina (SRE): Action queue (short):
- Multi-region failover drill (owner: Tom H) 10-day mini-sprint, acceptance: RTO < 45s for control-plane ops; no regional 5xx during failover.
- Model-registry auth jitter + CB (owner: Priya) week, acceptance: auth error rate < 0.5% under simulated token storm; no more than 1% increase in p95 latency.
- Post-deploy smoke tests (owner: Marcus) add to CI, acceptance: smoke pass before traffic switch.
- Vendor escalation contacts + SLA card (owner: CloudCo) week, acceptance: PagerDuty entries updated and secondary contact verified.
Tom H: Suggest adding a recurrence-detection dashboard for vendor-related spikes (metric: `vendor_deps_error_spike_count`). If we see >3 spikes in 30 days, auto-open a retrospective ticket. I'll sketch DASH.
Priya: I'll add metrics: `model_registry_auth_error_rate` and `model_registry_cb_trips`. Alerting: `auth_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m` and `cb_trips > 10/min`.
Marcus (Infra): Draft pipeline job: `ci/jobs/post_deploy_smoke.sh` -> runs `tools/auth_flood_test.py` and `curl -sfS http://model-registry/health`. Will attach PR later.
Elena (Platform PM): Dry run window? We need to avoid product-deploy days. Proposed: 2026-04-12 10:00 PT.
Tom H: Works for me. Locking 2026-04-12 10:00 PT for the cross-region failover dry run and joint test with CloudCo.
VendorOps: CloudCo: We can be on the call for 2026-04-12 and will enable test endpoint between 09:45-11:00 PT.
Nina (SRE): Good. A few clarifications: (1) add PR links + owners in the tracker, (2) schedule a follow-up review 1 week after sprint end to look for recurrence trends.
Priya: PR coming in today for jitter + CB. I'll include unit tests that simulate token TTL expiry paths and a simple integration test against the staging registry mock.
Marcus (Infra): I'll create the CI PR by tomorrow and add the smoke job to the required checks for the model-registry service.
Tom H: I'll own the playbook updates: `/playbooks/vendor-fallbacks.md`. Will add rollback triggers: `if 5xx_rate > 1% for 3m -> rollback`.
Nina (SRE): Acceptance criteria recap: control-plane RTO < 45s, service 5xx during tests = 0, auth_error_rate < 0.5% sustained for 5m under simulated load. Also: vendor contacts in PagerDuty.
Elena (Platform PM): I'll draft the customer-facing note template and share with stakeholders once owners confirm timelines.
Oncall Bot: Reminder set: dry-run simulation 2 days before 2026-04-12. Recurring monthly mini-drill created (15m).
VendorOps: CloudCo: Sending escalation card now, attaching recommended client-side retry windows: `200ms, 500ms, 1s` backoff and `max_retries=3`.
Priya: Will implement recommended retry windows and test interplay with CB.
Nina (SRE): Great. Tom/Marcus/Priya please drop tracker link here once created. We'll treat this as a focused remediation sprint with a 1-week review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
